title: NYC South Asian Comedy Festival - Brown Unhinged

long_description:
The unhinged comedy show where explore some taboo topics.

About this Event

No filter. No apologies. Brown Unhinged is the rawest, most uncensored night of the NYC South Asian Comedy Festival — bringing the boldest South Asian comedians to the iconic Broadway Comedy Club stage in the heart of Manhattan.
Step & repeat photo wall on-site — strike a pose before you take your seat.
This is stand-up comedy stripped of the polish: edgy, unapologetic, and unmistakably South Asian. If Opening Night was the warm welcome, Brown Unhinged is where the gloves come off.
The Lineup:
🎙️ Host: Sandeep Sen - NY Times, 2× Comedy Fight Club Champion, NYC Club Comic
🎤 Pallavi Gunalan - Dropout TV, SF Sketchfest, New York Comedy Festival, K*ll Tony
🎤 Sunil Mashari — Dubai-based comedian and one of the UAE comedy circuit's leading hosts
🎤 Dimitri Wejaysingher — NYC comic tackling race, identity, and social commentary, Harlem Comedy Festival alum
🎤 Fizaa Dosani - Netflix Is A Joke Festival, ABC/FX/Netflix credits, NYT-featured touring comedy show
🎤 Piyali Syam — NYC actor/writer, Today Show–featured comic and PIT SoloCom Festival performer
🎤 Ali Mehedi - CBC Canada, Halifax Comedy Festival, New York Comedy Festival, Laughing Lassi Producer
🌟 Headliner: TBA
Part of the NYC South Asian Comedy Festival — New York's first, and the world's largest, South Asian comedy festival, running October 16–18, 2026. Recommended for mature audiences. Tickets are limited and early bird pricing is available now.
